title: West Bengal Secures 3 New GI Tags: Jalbhara Sandesh, Manohara, & Balagarh Wooden Boats
summary: Increases West Bengal's total GI registrations to 59, making it India's 3rd-highest GI-tagged state.

blocks.content: Increases West Bengal's total GI registrations to 59, making it India's 3rd-highest GI-tagged state.

items: New GI Products: Chandannagar's Jalbhara Sandesh, Janai's Manohara sweet, and Balagarh traditional wooden boats.
